primary_object_card.object_statement: The DeepStackIntegrationEstate is the finite roster of system tools and libraries, each required to pass a runtime-bound deep stress ladder and representative integration use before its nested Codex skill may report it as operational.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: The job is deep stress testing every system tool and library to ensure integration and operation, not running every repo surface.
Package truth is runtime-specific, and import reachability is weaker than function-level integration.
The current Python, Julia, proof, graph, topology, tensor, dynamics, and optional-project families are separated into active, optional, quarantined, and avoid buckets.
A tool is integrated only when a real API changes, constrains, certifies, or falsifies a bounded result with controls and a demotion condition.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: This object is the operational tool and library estate itself. Every current system member is tracked through the runtime where it really lives, a real API stress ladder, negative and boundary behavior, adjacent-tool interaction, representative use by existing simulation code, independent Lev execution, and a reproducible nested Codex skill. The object is not a count of repository surfaces, not proof that the Ratchet or QIT engines are finished, and not a package-import scoreboard.

native_terms.deep stress ladder: A staged test sequence covering runtime identity, real APIs, positives, negatives, boundaries, stress cases, demotion behavior, and representative integration use.
native_terms.tool integration receipt: A hash-bound result naming the exact API, inputs, outputs, controls, failure mode, source, runtime, and downstream integration consequence.
native_terms.nested operational skill: A repo-held Codex skill with child family routes and executable validators or runners that reproduce and diagnose one bounded tool family.
native_terms.representative sim consumer: An existing simulation selected because it genuinely exercises the tool API, not because every simulation surface must be rerun.
native_terms.operational: The strongest local status supported by runtime, stress, integration, Lev, and skill receipts without implying scientific proof or promotion.

weirdness_signature: the unit of coverage is a tool or library rather than a repository surface
deep integration requires failure and demotion behavior rather than import success
preexisting simulations are representative consumers and stress fixtures rather than an exhaustive run list
nested skills must reproduce and diagnose execution but cannot inherit scientific authority from Lev
primary_object_card.domain: the finite current system roster across canonical Python, strict and isolated Julia projects, proof runtimes, source checkouts, and Lev execution adapters
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: a per-tool operational matrix, deep stress receipts, representative integration receipts, nested Codex skills, and Lev scorecards with explicit red or blocked states
allowed_operations: inventory current members and keep proposed or replacement candidates separate
run read-only runtime and installer preflights
execute bounded API, negative, boundary, stress, coupling, and representative-sim tests
repair sources, validators, isolated runtime declarations, and nested Codex skills
execute deterministic command suites through pinned Lev
preserve red and blocked receipts without requiring scientific promotion
required_invariants: every status names the exact runtime or source checkout that was tested
no tool is integrated from import success or package declaration alone
every deep-stress claim includes positive, negative, boundary, stress, and demotion behavior
representative simulations are selected for genuine API use rather than surface-count completion
preexisting red scientific outcomes do not prevent operational tool stress testing
nested skill guidance and executable skill provenance remain separate claims
Lev execution records real commands and cannot promote a scientific claim
current members, optional candidates, quarantined routes, and avoid-list packages remain separate
forbidden_substitutions: repository surface count as tool integration depth
run every simulation as a substitute for representative integration testing
package import or version label as operational integration
aggregate green count as a substitute for per-tool red and demotion behavior
scientific proof completeness as a prerequisite for operational stress testing
Claude roster prose or candidate status as Codex authority
one parent skill label as proof that nested executable routes ran
negative_controls: run a tool under the wrong interpreter or Julia project and require wrong-runtime classification
bypass or erase the named API and require the integration status to demote
remove a boundary or negative case and require the deep-stress receipt to block
supply a stale nested-skill or runner hash and require provenance validation to fail
execute a zero-command Lev suite and require fail-closed blocking
pass an isolated API fixture while its representative sim consumer bypasses the tool and require the integration claim to remain partial
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: Runtime adapters, representative sims, and Lev suites may operationalize one tool family only when they preserve exact runtime, API, control, stress, demotion, and receipt identities; adapters never become scientific proof or finished-engine claims.
promotion_locks: no import-only row may be called integrated
no API-only row may be called representative-sim integrated
no self-reported skill receipt may earn executable L3 without independent Lev evidence
no Lev projection may turn a red tool or sim result green
no optional or quarantined package may become a current member without an explicit authority update
blocked_downstream_consumers: all-tools-integrated claim while any current-member row lacks deep stress and representative use
all-nested-skills-operational claim while any child route is guidance-only or unexecuted
scientific promotion from operational stress receipts
release claim from projection-only Lev scorecards

lateral_mappings.label: runtime doctor and package inventory
lateral_mappings.target: canonical Python, Julia carrier and isolated projects, proof binaries, and source checkouts
preconditions: the exact interpreter or active project is recorded
import success remains below integration status
lateral_mappings.kill_control: if the same row passes under a wrong runtime without demotion, the adapter evidence fails

lateral_mappings.label: representative preexisting simulation
lateral_mappings.target: an existing sim whose execution path genuinely invokes the selected tool API
loses: proof that every repo surface works
preconditions: static and runtime evidence both show the tool API is reached
the tool has an individual deep-stress receipt
lateral_mappings.kill_control: bypass the tool in the consumer; the representative integration status must demote

lateral_mappings.label: pinned Lev command suite
lateral_mappings.target: deterministic execution, artifact hashing, negative controls, and projection verdicts
preconditions: suite bytes and executor commit are pinned
all command artifacts are independently rehashed
lateral_mappings.kill_control: erase all command cases; Lev must block with zero execution

lateral_mappings.label: surface and simulation count
lateral_mappings.target: a numerical count of files, sims, or repo surfaces touched
preconditions: used only as an inventory statistic
never used as the operational completion gate
lateral_mappings.kill_control: increase the file count without adding a tool receipt; operational completion must not change

root_constraints: finite current-member tool and library roster
order-sensitive runtime, API, control, integration, skill, and Lev validation sequence
extended_constraints: pinned Lev execution and artifact hashing

fixation_breakers: separate current system members from proposed replacements before testing
demote any import-green row that lacks failure and representative-use receipts
sample representative sims by genuine tool reachability rather than repository prominence

loop_contract.repair_rule: repair the first missing stage in a tool's runtime-to-API-to-stress-to-integration-to-skill-to-Lev chain before widening that tool packet
loop_contract.stop_condition: every current-member tool is deep-stress passed, honestly red, or blocked with a reproducible reason, and every operational nested skill has an independent Lev execution receipt

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question asks for an answer; it is not authorization to implement unless the user explicitly says to do it.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: The runtime, API, stress, integration, skill, and Lev order must be checked separately from content correctness, with the order witness named.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: When debugging runtime behavior, preserve the baseline tool roster and prior red receipts while repairing the execution path underneath.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: A Popper pass names the target tool-integration claim, strongest live falsifier, decisive check, and killed/open/survived classification before agreement.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: A Feynman pass names the tool operation, the observable measured, and the pass/fail condition.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must name distinct tool, sim, skill, and Lev receipts and explicitly refuse the merge into scientific or full-engine truth.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve discoverable runtime, source, and receipt questions with tools before asking; ask the human only for private, preference-bound, or unrecoverable information.

evidence_spine.wizard_runtime: Wizard v4.3 object-preservation guard only; no v4.2 current-run handoff and no full council claim from this validation.

source_math_locks.preserves: sim-mode tool/function fanout, exact worker truth, serial mutation, and bounded receipt rules
canonical runtime locations, isolated-project boundaries, and import-versus-integration separation
current, optional, quarantined, and avoid-list roster families
public status labels, per-tool micro-first order, and no narrative substitution

sim_audit_receipts.claim_ceiling: broad prior integration diagnostic and source map; not per-tool deep-stress completion
independent Lev execution of one skill validator only

evidence_spine.claim_ceiling: operational tool and library inventory, deep-stress, representative-integration, nested-skill, and Lev execution evidence only; no scientific or finished-engine claim
blocked_consumers: release claim from projection-only Lev evidence
